name: Technopark-Mordovia Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute profile describes Technopark Data Center in Saransk/Mordovia as the core IT services facility for the republic, Tier IV design certified, about 110 racks and 1,900 kW.

name: IXcellerate Moscow South Campus
notes: Operator page says the 14 ha Moscow South campus is IXcellerate's biggest project, planned as four data centers with up to 300+ MW and 19,300 racks; MOS5 listed at 64 MW/5,002 racks.

name: IXcellerate Veshki Campus (MOS11/MOS12)
notes: DCD reports IXcellerate acquired a 5.5 ha site near Veshki in Mytishchi, Moscow Region, for a third campus delivering 7,500 racks and over 130 MW across MOS11 and MOS12; MOS11 due summer 2026, MOS12 construction planned 2027.

name: DataPro Moscow II
notes: Data Center Map lists DataPro Moscow II in Khimki, Moscow Region, launched in 2020 with 1,600 racks and 11 MW; third-party directory evidence.

name: Cloud.ru Domodedovo Data Center
notes: DCD reports Cloud.ru began construction of its first owned data center, expected to commission in 2027; Vedomosti sources place it in Domodedovo, Moscow Region, with about 11 MW and 890 racks.

name: IXcellerate Moscow North Campus
notes: Operator page says the Altufyevo campus in northern Moscow began in 2011 and includes MOS1/MOS2 operational plus MOS3/MOS4 built/designed; MOS1 alone is 13.7 MW and 1,835 racks.

name: Selectel Yurlovsky Data Center
notes: DCD reports Selectel planned a 20 MW, 4,500 sqm Moscow facility called Yurlovsky, designed for up to 2,000 racks and Tier IV standards.

name: Rostelecom NORD-5
notes: DCD reports Rostelecom launched NORD-5 on DataLine's Nord campus in northern Moscow; 1,500 sqm and 600 racks, each up to 20 kW.

name: Rostelecom Biryulevo Hyperscale Campus
notes: DCD reports Rostelecom DPC acquired a facility at Nikopolskaya Street in Biryulevo and planned four buildings totaling 40,000 sqm, 55 MW and 6,710 racks.

name: M1 Data Center
notes: Operator page says M1 is at 125 Varshavskoye Avenue, Moscow, operational since 2006, with five server rooms totaling 1,700 sqm and more than 1,100 racks.

name: Moscow M9 Data Center
notes: Third-party directories list M9 at 7 Ulitsa Butlerova, Moscow, as a major interconnection site with 840 kW capacity and many listed networks/exchanges.

name: Rostelecom Arctic Data Center
notes: DCD reports Rostelecom launched commercial operations of its first Arctic-zone data center in Murmansk; current capacity 20 racks with expansion potential and roughly RUB300m investment.

name: Gazprom Veliky Novgorod Data Center
notes: Russian business press citing Vedomosti reports Gazprom plans a large Veliky Novgorod data center with about 5,000 racks, full operation targeted for 2028 and estimated cost around RUB450bn; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: RTK-TsOD Nizhny Novgorod Data Center
notes: DCD reports RTK-TsOD launched the Nizhny Novgorod data center at 35 Fedoseenko Street; 3,539 sqm, four machine rooms, 401 racks and 5 MW IT capacity.

name: Rostelecom Novosibirsk Tier III Data Center
notes: Rostelecom official release announces launch of a Tier III Novosibirsk data center with 3 MW power capacity and 300 client racks across three machine rooms.

name: Key Point Novosibirsk Data Center
notes: DCD reports Key Point broke ground in Novosibirsk with Beeline/VimpelCom as anchor tenant; full build-out Tier III-quality facility planned at 8 MW and 880 racks.

name: Smartcom Data Center
notes: RUVDS facility profile says AO Smartcom's data center is located in Omsk, built on a B2B carrier core, with dual independent power inputs, UPS, mobile diesel generators, N+1 precision cooling and carrier-neutral connectivity.

name: Fort Data Center
developer: Complex Information Technologies and Systems LLC
notes: AllDC catalog lists Fort at 132 Kuybysheva Street, Omsk, launched commercially 2016-09-01, with 8 racks and 0.16 MW total/guaranteed power.

name: Orenburzhye SEZ Digital Data Processing Center
developer: Center of Digital Data Processing resident company
notes: Expert-Ural, citing the Orenburg governor/government press service, reports the SEZ expert council approved a digital data processing center as the first IT resident of Orenburzhye SEZ; construction planned for H2 2025 and commissioning H1 2026.

name: MegaFon Orenburg Data Center
notes: TAdviser product entry reports MegaFon opened a modern data processing center in Orenburg in summer 2012; capacity not disclosed in accessible snippet.
